rules.requirement: All SWMS involving work at height must include a rescue plan with named rescue provider and response time.
Scaffold SWMS must reference scaffold design drawings or engineer certification.
Hot work permit required for any cutting, welding, or grinding within 10m of combustible materials.
Ladders not permitted as a work platform. Access ladders permitted for transfer only.
SWMS must declare all applicable HRCW categories. Undeclared HRCW is grounds for return.

structural_expectations: Method sequence must be chronologically credible
Controls must lead with physical hazard controls, not admin
Hold points must name the approval authority
Stop work triggers must be tied to the dominant failure mode
